opening.argument: The speaker presents Mirror Trading International as an automated Bitcoin trading pool, attributing its activity to "advanced digital software and artificial intelligence" operating on international markets. He promises that "minimum of $100 daily profits" will be added to member accounts, while instructing prospective participants to transfer money into the pool. Access to binary bonuses is tied to a $200 pool balance and $100 contributors on both the left and right sides of the structure, showing that participation is connected to recruitment and payment conditions. The offer further imposes a seven-day registration deadline and offers to advance or defer the entry amount. The available evidence does not establish whether payments, profits, or the deadline were fulfilled.
